# Support policy

Teslatlas Hub is provided without a support commitment under GNU AGPL.

Public issues may be used for reproducible bugs and documentation defects. Do not submit secrets, personal data, legal demands or undisclosed vulnerabilities.

Only environments listed in a tagged release are supported for that release. Planned Linux support is not a promise to support every distribution or init system.

Paid support, hosting, warranty, service levels or indemnity require a separate written agreement with MAGRATHEAN UK LTD.

Magrathean does not support modified or third-party builds unless agreed in writing. A fork must not present itself as an official supported release.
